blocks.title: Dissolution
blocks.text: Kisi solute (ghulne wali cheez) ko solvent (ghulane wali cheez) mein ghulane ke process ko dissolution kehte hain.
Maana jata hai ke solution teen steps mein banta hai:

items: Solvent ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces ko kamzor kar ke solute ke liye jagah banana (solvent ka phailna).
Solute ko us ke alag alag hisson (ions ya molecules) mein todna (solute ka phailna).
Solute aur solvent ko aapas mein milne (interact karne) dena taa ke solution ban jaye.

blocks.text: Is process mein heat ya to nikalti hai ya absorb hoti hai. Ise describe karne ke liye standard enthalpy change of solution istemal hoti hai.
